permissionKeys.description:
Array of permission key strings defining the capability set for the role.

This collection completely replaces the existing permission set when processed. Each string must match one of the allowed permission keys:

| Permission Key | Capability |
|---|---|
| `org:manage` | Organization management - manage organization settings, structure |
| `employee:manage` | Employee management - create, update, deactivate employees |
| `employee:view` | Employee viewing - view employee records and details |
| `project:manage` | Project management - create, update, archive, complete projects |
| `project:view` | Project viewing - view project records and details |
| `time:manage` | Time tracking management - manage timelogs and timers |
| `time:approve` | Time approval - approve or reject timesheets |
| `time:view_all` | View all time records - view timelogs for all employees |
| `report:view` | Report viewing - access organizational reports and dashboards |

The role's previous permissions are removed before these are assigned in a single transaction. No partial application occurs.
permissionKeys.x-autobe-specification: Collection of permission keys provided by the client via request body. Maps to no single database column; instead drives transactional deletion of existing `hrm_platform_role_permissions` records for the target role, then insertion of new records for each key. Validates all items against the allowed enumeration of permission keys. Enforces uniqueItems to prevent duplicate permissions. The roleId is excluded as a path parameter (resolved from URL), id is auto-generated by the database, and timestamps (created_at, updated_at) are system-managed. Implementation: query `hrm_platform_roles` to validate `roleId` exists, belongs to the current `hrm_platform_organization_id` context, and `built_in` is false. Throw 404 if not found or 403 if built-in or cross-organization.

IHrmPlatformRole.IPermissionUpdate.description:
Request payload for updating a custom role's permission set within an organization.

This DTO replaces an existing custom role's permission keys through a transactional operation that deletes current role-permission mappings and inserts new records based on the provided permission keys. Built-in roles (Owner, Manager, Employee) cannot be updated via this operation.

The endpoint performs a database transaction: soft-delete or hard-delete existing `hrm_platform_role_permissions` for the target `roleId`, then inserts new records matching the provided `permissionKeys` array. Returns the aggregated permission state via `IHrmPlatformRolePermission`.

Permission keys represent discrete platform capabilities controlling member actions: Organization management (org:manage), Employee management (employee:manage) and viewing (employee:view), Project management (project:manage) and viewing (project:view), Time tracking management (time:manage), Time approval (time:approve), View all time records (time:view_all), and Report viewing (report:view).
IHrmPlatformRole.IPermissionUpdate.x-autobe-specification: Request body schema for updating custom role permissions. The `permissionKeys` array drives a transaction: soft-delete/hard-delete existing `hrm_platform_role_permissions` records for the role, then insert new records for each provided key. Validates keys against allowed enumeration (org:manage, employee:manage, employee:view, project:manage, project:view, time:manage, time:approve, time:view_all, report:view). Enforces uniqueItems constraint. Excludes roleId (path parameter), id (auto-generated), and timestamps (system-managed) from this DTO as they are handled by the API operation.

IHrmPlatformProjectMembership.ICreate.description: Request body for creating a project membership by assigning an active employee to a project with a specific capacity role. The capacity role determines the employee's permissions within this project: project leads can manage tasks while regular members can only view tasks and log time. The employee must belong to the same organization as the target project.
IHrmPlatformProjectMembership.ICreate.x-autobe-specification: Maps employeeId to hrm_platform_employee_id column. Maps capacityRole to capacity_role column. Excludes hrm_platform_project_id (provided in path as projectId). Backend validates employee is active, belongs to same organization as project, and duplicate membership does not exist. Auto-generates id, created_at, updated_at.

IHrmPlatformProject.description:
Complete project entity in the HRM platform.

Projects serve as work containers for organizing tasks, tracking time, and managing team membership within an organization. Each project belongs to exactly one organization for multi-tenancy data isolation.

## Identification

- `id`: Unique UUID primary key for project identification
- `name`: Required project name displayed in list views and search results
- `color_code`: Hex color code for visual differentiation in UI components

## Details

- `description`: Optional detailed project description and scope documentation
- `budget`: Optional estimated hours budget for tracking against actual logged hours

## Lifecycle

- `status`: Operational state — Active (work proceeds normally), Archived (work concluded, data preserved), or Completed (work finished, no new activities)
- `start_date`: Optional planned or actual project commencement date
- `end_date`: Optional planned or actual project completion date

## Relationships

- `organization`: The owning organization returned as a summary object providing organizational context

## Audit Trail

- `created_at`: Immutable record of project creation timestamp
- `updated_at`: Last modification timestamp tracking all project changes
- `deleted_at`: Soft delete marker — null when project is active
IHrmPlatformProject.x-autobe-specification: Maps hrm_platform_projects table columns directly. FK column hrm_platform_organization_id transformed to organization object reference via JOIN to hrm_platform_organizations, returning IHrmPlatformOrganization.ISummary. Has-many relations (memberships, tasks, timelogs, hrmPlatformTimers) excluded from Read DTO per operation specification — accessed via dedicated endpoints. Soft-deleted projects filtered by deleted_at IS NULL in queries. All nullable database fields use oneOf pattern with null type.

status.description:
Filter timesheets by workflow status.

Restricts results to a single workflow state (draft, submitted, approved, or rejected). When omitted, timesheets in all states are returned.

The actual week_end_date is not directly queried; instead this parameter anchors the start of the date range for filtering timesheets whose week period begins on or after this value.

weekEndDate.description:
Filter timesheets whose week period starts on or before this date.

Specifies the ending boundary of the week date range as an ISO 8601 date-time string. Can be used alone or combined with weekStartDate to define a bounded range.
weekEndDate.x-autobe-specification: Computed range filter parameter. Converts the provided date-time value into a <= condition on week_start_date column. Combined with weekStartDate to form a date range filter on timesheets whose week period starts on or before this value.

employeeId.description:
Filter timesheets by specific employee.

Restricts results to timesheets owned by the employee identified by this UUID. Uses the employee record ID from the organization context.
employeeId.x-autobe-specification: Direct mapping to hrm_platform_employee_id column for equality filtering. Applied as WHERE hrm_platform_employee_id = value condition. Accepts UUID-formatted employee identifiers.

page.description:
Page number for pagination.

1-indexed page number for navigating through the result set. Page 1 returns the first set of records. Defaults to 1 when omitted.
page.x-autobe-specification: Pagination offset parameter. 1-indexed page number. Combined with limit to calculate SQL OFFSET: (page - 1) * limit. Defaults to 1 when not provided.

limit.description:
Maximum number of timesheets per page.

Controls how many records are returned in each page, ranging from 1 to 100. Defaults to 20 when omitted.
limit.x-autobe-specification: Pagination size parameter. Sets the maximum number of records returned per page equivalent to SQL LIMIT clause. Accepts integers from 1 to 100. Defaults to 20 when not provided.

IHrmPlatformTimesheet.IRequest.description:
Query parameters for filtering and paginating timesheet listings.

Filter timesheets by workflow status (draft, submitted, approved, rejected), week date range boundaries, or specific employee. Combine multiple filters to narrow results. When no filters are provided, all accessible timesheets are returned sorted by week start date in descending order.

Each property is optional—sending only the parameters you need produces targeted filtering.
IHrmPlatformTimesheet.IRequest.x-autobe-specification:
Search and filter request body for the PATCH /hrmPlatform/member/timesheets endpoint. Applies filters to hrm_platform_timesheets table:

1. status: equals match on status column (values: draft, submitted, approved, rejected)
2. weekStartDate/weekEndDate: range conditions on week_start_date column (>= and <= respectively, independently combinable)
3. employeeId: equals match on hrm_platform_employee_id column
4. page/limit: pagination parameters for result set

All properties are optional. Results sorted by week_start_date descending by default. Organization context scoping enforced via middleware.

IHrmPlatformTask.IRequest.description:
Request parameters for searching, filtering, sorting, and paginating task lists within the HRM platform.

Supports text search across task titles and descriptions, filtering by lifecycle status and priority level, assignment status, project scope, parent task, and temporal ranges. Includes configuration for result ordering and pagination controls.
IHrmPlatformTask.IRequest.x-autobe-specification:
search: GIN trigram index query on title and description columns. 
status: exact match filter (open, in-progress, completed, closed).
priority: exact match filter (low, medium, high, urgent).
assignedEmployeeId: FK match on hrm_platform_employee_id.
projectId: FK match on hrm_platform_project_id.
parentId: FK match on parent_id.
Date ranges: createdAtFrom/To, updatedAtFrom/To, dueAtFrom/To map to respective datetime columns with >= and <= operators.
Sorting: sortBy accepts 'dueAt', 'priority', 'createdAt'. sortOrder accepts 'asc', 'desc'.
Pagination: page (min 1), limit (min 1, max 100). All optional per IRequest rules.

IHrmPlatformTaskHistory.description:
Task status change history record.

Represents an immutable audit trail entry recording a single status transition applied to a task. Each entry captures the previous status (oldStatus), the new status assigned (newStatus), the member who initiated the change, the task that was modified, and the timestamp of the transition.

Status values are constrained to: open, in-progress, completed, closed. These records cannot be modified or deleted after creation and support dispute resolution, compliance auditing, and workflow analysis.

BELONGS-TO relations: task via hrm_platform_task_id FK to hrm_platform_tasks.id → IHrmPlatformTask.ISummary ($ref). member via hrm_platform_member_id FK to hrm_platform_members.id → IHrmPlatformMember.ISummary ($ref).

IHrmPlatformTimelog.IRequest.description:
Filtering, sorting, and pagination parameters for timelog discovery.

Defines the input constraints for the timelog index operation to support efficient list retrieval.

Supports temporal scoping (date_from, date_to), association scoping (project_id, task_id), billable status toggling, and description keyword matching (search). Includes pagination controls (page, limit) and result ordering (sort). This DTO does not represent a stored entity but dictates SQL WHERE and OFFSET/LIMIT logic directly.
IHrmPlatformTimelog.IRequest.x-autobe-specification: Request schema for searching, filtering, and paginating timelog records from hrm_platform_timelogs. Supports date range queries (date_from <= date <= date_to), equality filters on project_id, task_id, and billable status. Text search on work_description via search parameter. Standard offset-based pagination with page and limit parameters. Sort parameter for flexible ordering against date, duration_minutes, and created_at fields. Authorization: Member is required; time:manage role expands scope from own logs to organization-wide logs.

IHrmPlatformDepartment.description: Full department entity record containing identification, hierarchical parent-child relationship through optional parent department reference, organizational context via organization reference, optional description text, and system-managed timestamps including creation, update, and soft-deletion states.
IHrmPlatformDepartment.x-autobe-specification: Direct mapping to hrm_platform_deployments. Resolves organization FK to IHrmPlatformOrganization.ISummary. parent_department_id resolves to IHrmPlatformDepartment.ISummary using oneOf for null. child_deployments is IHrmPlatformDepartment.ISummary[]. employees is IHrmPlatformEmployee.ISummary[]. Excluded: raw FK scalars (hrm_platform_organization_id, hrm_platform_parent_department_id).

id.description:
Unique identifier for the task.

Universally Unique Identifier (UUID) that serves as the primary key for task records across all operations including listing, detail retrieval, updates, and history tracking.
id.x-autobe-specification: Direct mapping from hrm_platform_tasks.id. UUID primary key uniquely identifying the task within the HRM platform.

title.description:
Core work description of the task.

Required field that identifies the task in list views and search operations. Contains a concise description of the work item to be completed within the project.
title.x-autobe-specification: Direct mapping from hrm_platform_tasks.title. Required non-null string field containing the core work description.

status.description:
Current lifecycle status of the task.

Tasks progress through four possible states: open (newly created or reopened), in-progress (actively being worked on), completed (work finished but not yet finalized), and closed (finalized and archived). Status transitions are tracked in the task history audit trail.
status.x-autobe-specification: Direct mapping from hrm_platform_tasks.status. String enum field representing the task lifecycle state. Allowed values: open, in-progress, completed, closed. Default: open.

priority.description:
Urgency level of the task.

Determines the priority sorting and visual prominence in task lists. Four levels are available: low (routine work), medium (standard priority), high (important deadline), and urgent (critical immediate attention required).
priority.x-autobe-specification: Direct mapping from hrm_platform_tasks.priority. String enum field representing the urgency level. Allowed values: low, medium, high, urgent.

estimated_hours.description:
Estimated work duration in hours.

Optional numeric field used for capacity planning and budget tracking comparisons. When null, no estimate has been set for the task. Can be used alongside actual logged hours from timelogs to measure estimate accuracy.
estimated_hours.x-autobe-specification: Direct mapping from hrm_platform_tasks.estimated_hours. Nullable Float (Double Precision) field representing estimated work duration in hours for capacity planning. Nullable - null means no estimate has been set.

due_at.description:
Optional due date for the task.

DateTime field (ISO 8601 format) indicating when the task work should be completed. Used for deadline tracking, overdue detection, and sorting. When null, the task has no specific deadline.
due_at.x-autobe-specification: Direct mapping from hrm_platform_tasks.due_at. Nullable DateTime (Timestamptz) field representing the work due date. Nullable - null means no due date has been set.

created_at.description:
Timestamp when the task was created.

Immutable system-managed field (ISO 8601 format) recording the exact date and time when the task was first created. Used for chronological sorting and audit purposes.
created_at.x-autobe-specification: Direct mapping from hrm_platform_tasks.created_at. Non-null DateTime (Timestamptz) field automatically set upon task creation.

project.description:
The parent project to which this task belongs.

Reference to the project summary containing the task. Tasks are strictly scoped to their parent project for data isolation and access control. This relation cannot be null as every task must belong to a project.
project.x-autobe-specification: BELONGS-TO relation from hrm_platform_tasks.hrm_platform_project_id to hrm_platform_projects. Joins via FK to return IHrmPlatformProject.ISummary. Required - every task belongs to exactly one project.

assignedEmployee.description:
Employee currently assigned to complete this task.

Optional reference to the employee summary responsible for this work item. When null, the task is unassigned and available for pickup. The assigned employee must belong to the same organization as the task's project.
assignedEmployee.x-autobe-specification: BELONGS-TO relation from hrm_platform_tasks.hrm_platform_employee_id to hrm_platform_employees. Joins via FK to return nullable IHrmPlatformEmployee.ISummary. Nullable - null means no employee is assigned to this task.

parentTask.description:
Optional parent task for subtask hierarchy.

Self-referencing relation indicating that this task is a subtask of another task. Supports only one level of nesting (parent → subtask, but no further nesting). When null, the task is a root-level task with no parent.
parentTask.x-autobe-specification: BELONGS-TO self-referencing relation from hrm_platform_tasks.parent_id to hrm_platform_tasks. Joins via FK to return nullable IHrmPlatformTask.ISummary. Nullable - null means this is a root-level task, not a subtask. Supports one-level nesting only.

IHrmPlatformTask.ISummary.description:
Summary representation of a task within a project, optimized for list displays and paginated search results.

Tasks represent discrete work items scoped to projects, progressing through lifecycle states: open, in-progress, completed, and closed. This summary includes the task identifier, title, current lifecycle status, priority level, estimated work hours, optional due date, and creation timestamp. Task-context relations expose the parent project, optionally assigned employee, and optional parent task for one-level subtask nesting.
IHrmPlatformTask.ISummary.x-autobe-specification: Direct mapping from hrm_platform_tasks table for summary display. Includes essential display fields (id, title, status, priority) and timeline fields (estimated_hours, due_at, created_at). FK columns (hrm_platform_project_id, hrm_platform_employee_id, parent_id) are transformed into $ref summary objects (project, assignedEmployee, parentTask) per relation mapping rules for Response DTOs. Excluded columns: description (large text, Section 2.2 summary optimization), updated_at (summary exclusion per convention), deleted_at (soft-delete marker not relevant for active summary lists). Excluded HAS-MANY relations: subtasks (recursive composition with separate listing), timelogs (aggregation with separate endpoint), hrmPlatformTimers (aggregation with separate endpoint), histories (aggregation with separate endpoint). All nullable DB fields use oneOf pattern with null type alternative.

description.description:
Optional work description providing context for the tracked time.

Use this field to add or modify details about what work is being tracked during the timer session. Setting to null removes the current description.
description.x-autobe-specification: Direct mapping from hrm_platform_timers.description column. Nullable — sending null removes the description. String type with oneOf pattern for nullability.

billable.description:
Whether the tracked time should be considered billable.

When true, the hours accumulated by this timer will count as billable work upon conversion to a timelog. When false, the time is tracked as non-billable internal work.
billable.x-autobe-specification: Direct mapping from hrm_platform_timers.billable column. Boolean scalar. Updates whether the timer's accumulated time will be considered billable when converted to a timelog.

projectId.description: UUID of the project for which time is being tracked. The project must exist within the current organization and have an active status. Changing the project reassigns the timer's ongoing time tracking to the new project.
projectId.x-autobe-specification: Direct mapping from hrm_platform_timers.hrm_platform_projects_id column. UUID string. Request DTO format keeps FK as scalar ID. Validates that project exists, belongs to current organization, and has active status.

taskId.description: UUID of the specific task being worked on, if any. Optionally ties the timer to a particular task within the project for granular time tracking. If changing this field, the task must belong to the (updated or existing) project. Send null to remove the task association.
taskId.x-autobe-specification: Direct mapping from hrm_platform_timers.hrm_platform_tasks_id column. Nullable UUID string. If provided, validates the task exists and belongs to the associated project. Request DTO format keeps FK as scalar ID.

IHrmPlatformTimer.IUpdate.description:
Request body for updating a running timer session.

Modify one or more fields of an active timer without stopping it. Only include the fields that need to be changed; all properties are optional.

Updates preserve the timer's active state and do not affect the start time. To stop a timer and generate a timelog, use the stop timer operation instead.
IHrmPlatformTimer.IUpdate.x-autobe-specification:
Partial update DTO for active timer sessions. All properties are optional to support selective field updates.

Field mappings:
- description → description (nullable string)
- billable → billable (boolean)
- projectId → hrm_platform_projects_id (UUID FK, validated to exist in current organization and be active)
- taskId → hrm_platform_tasks_id (nullable UUID FK, validated to belong to the associated project)

Immutable exclusions:
- hrm_platform_members_id: actor identity resolved from JWT, not user-provided
- hrm_platform_employees_id: timer ownership resolved from JWT, not user-provided
- started_at / stopped_at: lifecycle state control — stopping timer creates timelog, not an update operation
- created_at / updated_at / deleted_at: system-managed timestamps
- id: immutable primary key

Validations on receive:
- projectId: must exist, belong to current organization, have status 'active'
- taskId: if provided, must belong to the (updated or existing) project and not be deleted
- If both projectId and taskId provided: taskId must belong to the NEW project

id.description:
Unique identifier for the employee record within the organization.

Automatically generated system field that serves as the primary key for employee lookup, updates, and deletion operations. Used in API path parameters for accessing employee details, contracts, and related resources.
id.x-autobe-specification: Direct mapping from hrm_platform_employees.id. Primary key UUID identifier for the employee record.

member.description:
The global member profile linked to this employee, containing the member's identity information across all organizational contexts.

Each employee record is connected to a global member account that persists across all organizations the person belongs to. This relation exposes the member's display name, email, avatar image, and phone number needed for directory displays.
member.x-autobe-specification: Join from hrm_platform_member_id to hrm_platform_members.id. Returns IHrmPlatformMember.ISummary with essential member profile data (display_name, email, avatar_image, phone_number).

role.description:
The organizational role assigned to this employee, defining their authorization template and permission set within the current organization.

Roles control what actions employees can perform. Built-in roles (Owner, Manager, Employee) are platform defaults with predefined permissions, while custom roles are created by organization owners for tailored permission configurations.
role.x-autobe-specification: Join from hrm_platform_role_id to hrm_platform_roles.id. Returns IHrmPlatformRole.ISummary with role name, built-in status, and description. Organization context filtered by active session.

department.description:
The organizational department grouping this employee belongs to, or null if they are not assigned to any department.

Optional department assignment used for organizational hierarchy and grouping. Employees without department assignment report directly at the organization level. Departments support one-level nesting hierarchy with optional parent departments.
department.x-autobe-specification: Join from hrm_platform_department_id (nullable) to hrm_platform_departments.id. Returns IHrmPlatformDepartment.ISummary or null when employee is not assigned to any department.

position.description:
The job title or position name for the employee within the organization.

Optional field providing descriptive context about the employee's role title, distinct from their organizational role assignment. Examples include Senior Developer, Marketing Manager, or Junior Accountant. Null indicates no position title has been set.
position.x-autobe-specification: Direct mapping from hrm_platform_employees.position. Nullable string field for employee job title or position name. Supports null when no position is defined.

employment_type.description:
The employment classification type for the employee.

Defines the employment arrangement: full-time, part-time, contractor, or intern. Used for payroll categorization, reporting, and organizational workforce composition tracking. Always present as every employee must have an employment type classification.
employment_type.x-autobe-specification: Direct mapping from hrm_platform_employees.employment_type. Non-null string enum representing the employment classification. Allowed values: full-time, part-time, contractor, intern.

status.description:
The current employment status of the employee within the organization.

Active employees can perform work, log time, submit timesheets, and participate in project activities. Deactivated employees have restricted access - they cannot log time or submit timesheets, but their historical data including timelogs and timesheets is preserved for audit and reporting purposes.
status.x-autobe-specification: Direct mapping from hrm_platform_employees.status. Non-null string enum representing current employment status. Allowed values: active, deactivated.

created_at.description:
Timestamp when the employee record was created in the organization.

System-managed field indicating when the employee was invited or added to the organization. Used for sorting, historical tracking of workforce composition, and audit trail purposes.
created_at.x-autobe-specification: Direct mapping from hrm_platform_employees.created_at. DateTime with date-time format. Automatically set when employee record is first created. Non-null.

IHrmPlatformEmployee.ISummary.description:
Summary representation of an organization-scoped employee record optimized for list displays and paginated search results.

Includes core employee identity, linked member profile context, assigned organizational role, optional department grouping, job position title, employment classification (full-time, part-time, contractor, intern), active/deactivated status, and the initial record creation timestamp. Designed for efficient directory views without heavy compositional data.
IHrmPlatformEmployee.ISummary.x-autobe-specification: Direct mapping from hrm_platform_employees table. JOINs: hrm_platform_members (via hrm_platform_member_id), hrm_platform_roles (via hrm_platform_role_id), hrm_platform_departments? (via hrm_platform_department_id). Business rules: department and position are nullable and must support null payloads. Pagination filters (search, department_id, employment_type, status) are handled by the IRequest DTO, not this response schema. Excludes hrm_platform_organization_id as it is enforced by the active session context.

timelogIds.description:
Array of timelog UUIDs to include in this timesheet.

This array represents the complete set of timelogs that should be associated with the timesheet. Timelogs already in the timesheet but not included in this array are automatically removed. New timelogs are added to the timesheet.

Each timelog must belong to the current employee, fall within the timesheet's week period boundaries (Monday to Sunday), and not be part of another timesheet. This operation is only permitted for timesheets in draft status.
timelogIds.x-autobe-specification: Computed array property that drives timelog association updates. The array contains UUID strings of timelogs to include in the timesheet. Not a direct database column — the endpoint specification computes additions and removals against the current timelogs relation, validates each timelog's employee ownership, date range compliance, and timesheet uniqueness, then updates hrm_platform_timesheet_id on the timelogs table accordingly. After processing, total_hours is recalculated from linked timelogs.

IHrmPlatformTimesheet.IUpdate.description:
Request body for updating a timesheet's timelog associations.

The timelogIds array represents the complete set of timelogs to include in this timesheet. Any timelogs currently in the timesheet but not included in this array are removed, and new timelogs are added. This operation is only available for timesheets in draft status — submitted, approved, or rejected timesheets cannot be modified.

All timelogs must belong to the current employee and fall within the timesheet's week period boundaries. Timelogs that are already part of another timesheet cannot be added.
IHrmPlatformTimesheet.IUpdate.x-autobe-specification: The timelogIds array represents the complete set of timelog UUIDs to associate with this timesheet. This is not a direct column mapping — the endpoint computes additions (timelogs in array but not currently linked) and removals (timelogs currently linked but not in array). For additions: validate each timelog belongs to the current employee, falls within the timesheet's [week_start_date, week_end_date] boundaries, and is not already in another timesheet. Then set hrm_platform_timesheet_id on the timelogs table. For removals: set hrm_platform_timesheet_id to null. After all changes, recalculate total_hours by summing duration_minutes / 60.0 for all timelogs linked to this timesheet, and update hrm_platform_timesheets.total_hours and updated_at.

id.description:
Unique identifier for this task history entry.

System-generated UUID that uniquely identifies this specific status change record in the audit trail.
id.x-autobe-specification: Direct mapping from hrm_platform_task_histories.id column. Primary key UUID.

old_status.description:
The task status before this change occurred.

Captures the previous lifecycle state of the task, such as open, in-progress, completed, or closed. This value is recorded at the time of transition and remains immutable.
old_status.x-autobe-specification: Direct mapping from hrm_platform_task_histories.old_status column. Represents the status of the task before the change was applied. Allowed values: open, in-progress, completed, closed.

The new status assigned to the task after this change.

Captures the resulting lifecycle state of the task following the transition, such as open, in-progress, completed, or closed. This value is immutable once recorded.
new_status.x-autobe-specification: Direct mapping from hrm_platform_task_histories.new_status column. Represents the new status assigned to the task after the change. Allowed values: open, in-progress, completed, closed.

Indicates the date and time when the transition occurred, formatted in ISO 8601. Used for building chronological audit trails.

member.description:
The member who initiated this status change.

Provides a summary profile of the user who performed the transition. Linked via the hrm_platform_member_id foreign key relationship, this preserves the actor identity even if their organizational role changes later.
member.x-autobe-specification: JOIN from hrm_platform_task_histories.hrm_platform_member_id to hrm_platform_members.id. Returns IHrmPlatformMember.ISummary. This expands the foreign key to display the full profile of the member who initiated the status change.

IHrmPlatformTaskHistory.ISummary.description:
Summary representation of a task status change history entry, designed for paginated list displays and chronological audit trail viewing.

Each record captures an immutable status transition of a task including the previous and new status values, when the change occurred, and which member initiated it. This summary is optimized for list views by including the expanded member profile while omitting redundant task references already implied by the URL path.
IHrmPlatformTaskHistory.ISummary.x-autobe-specification: Direct mapping from hrm_platform_task_histories for summary view. Includes id, old_status, new_status, created_at as direct column mappings. Excludes hrm_platform_task_id and task relation as both are redundant with the URL path context (/tasks/{taskId}/histories).

Start date for filtering snapshots. Includes snapshots created on or after this date.

Current page number for pagination.

IHrmPlatformOrganizationSnapshot.IReques.description:
Request parameters for filtering and paginating organization configuration snapshots.

Filter historical snapshots by date range, currency code, timezone, acting member ID, or organization name. All filter fields are optional. Supports pagination with page and limit parameters. Default sorting is by creation date descending (most recent first).

Pagination defaults to page=1, limit=20 if omitted. Sorting defaults to created_at DESC. Authenticated member must have organization context access.

week_start_date.description:
The Monday start date of the weekly tracking period.

Defines the beginning of the 7-day timesheet window. The system calculates the corresponding Sunday end date. All timelogs for the authenticated employee within this date range are automatically included in the draft timesheet.
week_start_date.x-autobe-specification: Direct mapping to hrm_platform_timesheets.week_start_date. User provides the Monday boundary for the weekly aggregation period. System uses this to calculate week_end_date and query matching timelogs.

IHrmPlatformTimesheet.ICreate.description:
Creates a new draft timesheet for the authenticated employee.

Specify the `week_start_date` to define the Monday of the tracking week. The system automatically calculates the week end date (Sunday), aggregates existing timelogs for that employee within the week, and computes total hours. Duplicate timesheets for the same employee and week period are prevented.
IHrmPlatformTimesheet.ICreate.x-autobe-specification: Maps week_start_date to hrm_platform_timesheets.week_start_date. System calculates week_end_date as Sunday of the same week, aggregates existing timelogs by querying hrm_platform_timelogs for the JWT-resolved employee within the week period, computes total_hours from summed duration_minutes, initializes status to 'draft', and auto-links matching timelogs via their timesheet FK. Auto-generated fields (id, created_at, updated_at, deleted_at) and computed/system-managed fields excluded. Actor identity (employee_id) resolved from JWT.

IHrmPlatformTask.ICreate.description: Creates a new task within a project. title is required to describe the work item or acceptance criteria. Optional fields include description for extended context, assigned_employee_id to assign an active project member, parent_id to nest as a subtask (one-level nesting enforced), status to override the default 'open' state with values like 'in-progress', priority to override the default 'medium' urgency level, estimated_hours as a number for work duration estimates, and due_at as a date-time string for scheduling deadlines.
IHrmPlatformTask.ICreate.x-autobe-specification: Direct: title, description, status, priority, estimated_hours, due_at. References: assigned_employee_id (FK to hrm_platform_employees), parent_id (FK recursive to hrm_platform_tasks). Path param excluded: hrm_platform_project_id from /{projectId}. Defaults applied server-side: status='open', priority='medium'. Auto-generated: id, created_at, updated_at.

end_date.description:
Optional completion date for the project.

When specified, sets the project's end date to the provided datetime value. If omitted, the system automatically uses the current timestamp as the project completion date.
end_date.x-autobe-specification: Direct mapping from hrm_platform_projects.end_date column (DateTime?). Optional field in the request body. When provided by the client, use the supplied date-time value. When omitted, the backend defaults end_date to NOW() during the project status transition from active to completed. The oneOf schema allows both date-time strings and null values to reflect DB nullability.

IHrmPlatformProject.ICompleteRequest.description:
Request payload for completing an active project.

Completing a project signals that all work scope has been finished. The completed status is terminal — completed projects cannot be reactivated. Users may optionally specify the completion date; if omitted, the system automatically uses the current timestamp.

## Completion Behavior

- The project status transitions from Active to Completed
- No further timelog entries, task assignments, or timer sessions are accepted
- All existing timelogs, tasks, and related data remain accessible for reporting
- This operation requires project management permissions

IHrmPlatformProjectBudgetReport.IRequest.description:
Request parameters for retrieving project budget utilization reports.

Filter projects by lifecycle status or search by name. Filter timelog aggregation by date range and billability. Control pagination with cursor, limit, or page number. Customize sorting with sort field and direction.

Computed aggregation request for the project budget utilization report endpoint. This DTO filters and paginates results across two database tables:

Project-level filters on hrm_platform_projects:
- status: Filter by project lifecycle status (active, archived, completed)
- searchTerm: Full-text search on project name using pg_trgm GIN index
- sortField/sortDirection: Override default created_at DESC sorting

Timelog-level filters on hrm_platform_timelogs:
- dateFrom/dateTo: Date range filter on timelog.date (inclusive bounds)

Pagination parameters:
- cursor: Cursor-based pagination using UUID from last item's id
- limit: Page size (1-100, defaults to 20)

Organization context is resolved from the authenticated member's active session (hrm_platform_organization_id). All parameters are optional; omitting filters returns all non-deleted projects in the active organization.

IHrmPlatformEmployeeContract.IUpdate.description:
Request body for updating an active employee contract's compensation terms and working conditions.

All fields are optional to support partial updates, allowing clients to modify only specific attributes without resubmitting the entire contract payload. The operation targets active contracts only — contracts with a past end date are immutable and cannot be modified through this endpoint.

IHrmPlatformProjectWeeklySummary.ISummar.description:
Weekly time tracking summary for a project, aggregating all non-deleted timelogs into Monday-through-Sunday week buckets.

Each record represents one calendar week of activity for a specific project, showing the total hours logged, number of timelog entries, and count of distinct employees who contributed time. This is a computed aggregation — not mapped to any database table.

Primarily used for week-by-week project time reports, budget utilization trend analysis, and organizational productivity dashboards.
IHrmPlatformProjectWeeklySummary.ISummar.x-autobe-specification:
Computed aggregation from hrm_platform_timelogs table. Query filters by hrm_platform_project_id = projectId AND deleted_at IS NULL. Results are grouped by the Monday of each week for the timelog date.

Aggregation logic:
- week_start: DATE_TRUNC to Monday of each week (ISO 8601 week start)
- week_end: week_start + 6 days (Sunday end of week)
- total_hours: SUM(duration_minutes) / 60, rounded to nearest minute
- timelogs_count: COUNT(*) of non-deleted timelog entries
- employee_count: COUNT(DISTINCT hrm_platform_employee_id)

Results ordered by week_start DESC (most recent week first). No joins required — all data sourced from the timelogs table directly.

Parent task references must belong to the same project to prevent circular references.

Maps to partial update on hrm_platform_tasks table.

All fields optional - omit fields to retain current values.

Validations:
- title: non-empty string if provided
- status: oneOf (open, in-progress, completed, closed). Server enforces forward transitions only.
- priority: oneOf (low, medium, high, urgent)
- estimatedHours: positive number (>0) if provided; null to clear
- dueAt: valid ISO 8601 datetime if provided; null to clear
- hrmPlatformEmployeeId: if provided, employee must be active and project membership must exist in hrm_platform_project_memberships; 400 if not a member
- parentId: if provided, parent task must exist in same project; 400 if parent belongs to different project or is a descendant (circular reference check)

Explicitly excluded: hrm_platform_project_id (cross-project movement rejected by backend).

Server-side: generates updated_at timestamp on save, creates hrm_platform_task_histories entry if status changes.

timelog_count.x-autobe-specification: Computed using COUNT(*) on hrm_platform_timelogs. Counts all timelog records whose date falls within the week boundaries (week_start inclusive to week_end inclusive).

employee_count.description: Number of distinct employees who logged time during the week period. Only counts employees with at least one timelog entry in the reporting week.

Displays week boundaries in ISO calendar format (Monday through Sunday), total hours worked by all employees, count of individual timelog entries, and number of distinct employees who logged time. status.x-autobe-specification: Direct mapping from hrm_platform_timesheets.status. Lifecycle values: draft (initial editable state), submitted (awaiting manager review), approved (finalized and timelogs locked), rejected (returned to draft for revision). State transitions follow the required workflow: draft -> submitted -> approved or rejected -> draft.

IHrmPlatformTimesheet.description:
Full detail entity representation of an employee's weekly timesheet, including aggregated timelogs, employee reference, review metadata, and workflow status.

Represents a weekly aggregation of an employee's time entries spanning Monday through Sunday, tracking the complete submission lifecycle from draft through manager review and approval or rejection. Includes the reviewing member's details when a review action has occurred, rejection reasons providing feedback, computed total hours, and all associated timelog records with their project/task details. Used for viewing complete timesheet details, workflow management for draft, submitted, approved, and rejected timesheets, and full audit trails.

Optional; omitting returns timers across all projects. Project must belong to authenticated member's active organization context enforced via session middleware.

Filters timers tracking work against the specified task (subtask or parent task). Requires valid UUID format matching hrm_platform_tasks table. Task must belong to a project within the authenticated member's organization. Omitting returns all timers, including those without task associations. Only matches timers where task reference is populated.
taskId.x-autobe-specification: Query parameter: Direct FK filter on hrm_platform_tasks_id column. WHERE hrm_platform_tasks_id = taskId UUID value. - true: Returns only timers with stopped_at IS NULL (currently running, time still tracking)
- false: Returns timers with stopped_at populated (completed sessions, stopped or discarded)

Omitting the filter returns all timers regardless of activity state. Used to scope results to currently active timers for live tracking views.

Specifies the latest point-in-time for timer start dates. Supports range queries for specific historical periods or recent time windows when combined with startedFrom. Example: "2024-03-31T23:59:59Z" returns timers started up to March 31st. Omitting returns all timer start times without upper limit.
startedTo.x-autobe-specification: Query parameter: Range filter on started_at column. WHERE started_at <= startedTo ISO 8601 date-time value. Server decodes cursor token to resume query from the last returned record position. Alternative to page-based pagination; use either cursor OR page-based pagination (limit/page). Omitting returns first page via default pagination.

IHrmPlatformTimer.IRequest.description:
Search and filter timer tracking sessions within the authenticated member's active organization.

Request supports full-text description search, entity ownership scoping (employee, project, task), timer activity status (running vs stopped), and start time range boundaries. Two pagination modes supported: cursor-based continuation with opaque cursor tokens, or page-based with explicit page numbers. All parameters are optional.

### Search & Filters
- `search`: Full-text matching against timer descriptions
- `employeeId`: Scope to specific employee's timers by UUID
- `projectId`: Scope to specific project timers by UUID
- `taskId`: Scope to specific task timers by UUID (nullable per timer)
- `active`: Boolean filter — true returns running timers (stopped_at IS NULL), false returns stopped timers
- `startedFrom`: ISO 8601 lower bound for started_at range
- `startedTo`: ISO 8601 upper bound for started_at range

### Pagination
- `cursor`: Opaque continuation token from previous page response
- `limit`: Result set size per page (1–100, defaults to system page size)
- `page`: 1-indexed page number for page-based pagination (defaults to 1)
IHrmPlatformTimer.IRequest.x-autobe-specification: Request body schema for PATCH /hrmPlatform/member/timers search/list operation. Filters timer tracking sessions via query parameters: full-text description search, entity FK filters (employeeId→hrm_platform_employees_id, projectId→hrm_platform_projects_id, taskId→hrm_platform_tasks_id), boolean active status from stopped_at IS NULL, date-time range on started_at (startedFrom/startedTo), and pagination via opaque cursor token with limit/page. Authenticated member scope enforced via JWT session — hrm_platform_members_id injected server-side. All parameters optional; omitting returns default paginated results. Organization context scoping applied via session middleware on hrm_platform_organizations via hrm_platform_members → employee → organization relationship chain.

employee.description:
Employee identity associated with the grouped time data.

Contains the employee summary when the report is grouped by employee dimension, including display name, role, department, employment type, and status. When grouped by project or task, this field may show the primary employee context or be null if the context is not applicable.
employee.x-autobe-specification: Computed via LEFT JOIN from hrm_platform_timelogs.hrm_platform_employee_id to hrm_platform_employees.id. When the grouping dimension is 'employee', this always contains the IHrmPlatformEmployee.ISummary for the grouped employee. When the grouping dimension is 'project' or 'task', this field reflects the primary employee context from the timelogs in that group and may be null if no employee context is available in the aggregation result. Returns IHrmPlatformEmployee.ISummary type.

Contains the project summary when the report is grouped by project dimension, including project name, color code, status, budget, and timeline information. When grouped by employee or task, this field may show the project context or be null if the context is not directly applicable.

When the grouping dimension is 'project', this always contains the IHrmPlatformProject.ISummary for the grouped project. When the grouping dimension is 'employee' or 'task', this field reflects the project context from the timelogs in that group and may be null if no project context is available. Returns IHrmPlatformProject.ISummary type.

When the grouping dimension is 'task', this always contains the IHrmPlatformTask.ISummary for the grouped task. When the grouping dimension is 'employee' or 'project', this field may be null as task detail is not the primary grouping context. Returns IHrmPlatformTask.ISummary type.

total_hours.description:
Total hours worked, including both billable and non-billable time.

Sum of all logged time entries for this group expressed in decimal hours. Computed by aggregating duration_minutes from matching timelogs and dividing by 60.
total_hours.x-autobe-specification: Computed aggregation: SUM(duration_minutes) / 60 from hrm_platform_timelogs within the filter criteria and grouping dimension. Sums all duration_minutes values for all timelogs matching the date range, organization, and optional filters, then divides by 60 to convert from minutes to decimal hours. Always non-negative. Number type.

billable_hours.description:
Billable hours representing time chargeable to clients.

Sum of all logged time entries marked as billable for this group, expressed in decimal hours. Used for client invoicing and revenue tracking calculations.
billable_hours.x-autobe-specification: Computed aggregation: SUM(CASE WHEN billable THEN duration_minutes ELSE 0 END) / 60 from hrm_platform_timelogs within the filter criteria and grouping dimension. Only sums duration_minutes where the billable column is true. Divides by 60 to convert from minutes to decimal hours. Always non-negative. Number type.

non_billable_hours.description:
Non-billable hours representing internal or overhead work time.

Sum of all logged time entries marked as non-billable for this group, expressed in decimal hours. Used for cost tracking and internal utilization analysis.
non_billable_hours.x-autobe-specification: Computed aggregation: SUM(CASE WHEN NOT billable THEN duration_minutes ELSE 0 END) / 60 from hrm_platform_timelogs within the filter criteria and grouping dimension. Only sums duration_minutes where the billable column is false. Divides by 60 to convert from minutes to decimal hours. Always non-negative. Number type.

IReportTime.description:
Aggregated time tracking report entry containing computed hourly statistics and entity context.

Represents a single grouped row in the time tracking report results. Each entry corresponds to one group key determined by the requested grouping dimension (employee, project, or task) and contains the total hours, billable hours, and non-billable hours for that group. Entity context fields provide identity information such as the employee who performed the work, the project being tracked, or the specific task being worked on.
IReportTime.x-autobe-specification:
Computed aggregation schema derived from hrm_platform_timelogs with LEFT JOINs to entity reference tables.

Query pattern:
- Aggregates hrm_platform_timelogs filtered by date range (from, to), organization context, and optional filters (employee_id, project_id, task_id, billable)
- LEFT JOIN to hrm_platform_employees via hrm_platform_employee_id for employee entity context
- LEFT JOIN to hrm_platform_projects via hrm_platform_project_id for project entity context
- LEFT JOIN to hrm_platform_tasks via hrm_platform_task_id for task entity context
- GROUP BY the specified grouping dimension: employee_id, project_id, or task_id

Calculations:
- total_hours = SUM(duration_minutes) / 60
- billable_hours = SUM(CASE WHEN billable THEN duration_minutes ELSE 0 END) / 60
- non_billable_hours = SUM(CASE WHEN NOT billable THEN duration_minutes ELSE 0 END) / 60

Entity context fields (employee, project, task) are populated based on the requested grouping dimension. The primary grouping entity is always populated; secondary entities may be null depending on the dimension.

Authorization: member actor scoped to current organization via middleware. Managers/owners can view all employees' timelogs. Employees without time:manage permission are filtered to their own hrm_platform_employee_id only.

hoursToday.description:
Sum of hours worked today.

Aggregated value calculated from the sum of all timelog durations for the current calendar date, converted from minutes to hours by dividing by 60. Returns 0 when no timelogs exist for today.
hoursToday.x-autobe-specification: Computation logic: SELECT SUM(duration_minutes)/60 FROM hrm_platform_timelogs WHERE hrm_platform_employee_id = employeeId AND date >= start_of_today() AND date < start_of_tomorrow() AND deleted_at IS NULL. Returns 0 when NULL (no matching timelogs). Query is scoped to the employee's organization context.

hoursThisWeek.description:
Sum of hours worked this week.

Aggregated value calculated from the sum of all timelog durations for the current week period (Monday through Sunday), converted from minutes to hours by dividing by 60. Returns 0 when no timelogs exist for the current week.
hoursThisWeek.x-autobe-specification: Computation logic: SELECT SUM(duration_minutes)/60 FROM hrm_platform_timelogs WHERE hrm_platform_employee_id = employeeId AND date >= start_of_monday() AND date < start_of_next_monday() AND deleted_at IS NULL. Returns 0 when NULL (no matching timelogs). Query uses Monday-to-Sunday week convention.

activeTimer.description:
Currently active timer session if one exists.

Represents the active real-time tracking session for the authenticated employee's ongoing work. Includes the project and optional task the timer is tracking. Returns null when no timer is currently running for this employee.

The active status is determined by whether stopped_at is null.
activeTimer.x-autobe-specification: Computation logic: SELECT from hrm_platform_timers WHERE hrm_platform_employees_id = employeeId AND stopped_at IS NULL AND deleted_at IS NULL. At most one record per employee. Joins with hrm_platform_projects for project name, hrm_platform_tasks for task title. Returns the timer summary object, or null if no active timer exists.

recentTimelogs.description:
The five most recent timelog entries.

Array of time tracking records representing the most recent work periods logged by the employee, ordered by creation time (most recent first). Each entry includes project context, task details (if tracked), work description, and billable status.

Limited to the 5 most recent entries for display efficiency.
recentTimelogs.x-autobe-specification: Computation logic: SELECT TOP 5 from hrm_platform_timelogs WHERE hrm_platform_employee_id = employeeId AND deleted_at IS NULL ORDER BY created_at DESC. Joins with hrm_platform_projects for project name and hrm_platform_tasks for task title. Returns array of up to 5 most recent timelog entries based on creation order.

pendingTimesheet.description:
Any draft or submitted timesheet awaiting approval.

Represents the most recent timesheet that is either in draft status (being prepared by the employee) or submitted status (awaiting manager review). Returns null when no timesheets require attention.

Timesheets track weekly work (Monday-Sunday) and support workflow states: draft, submitted, approved, rejected.
pendingTimesheet.x-autobe-specification: Computation logic: SELECT from hrm_platform_timesheets WHERE hrm_platform_employee_id = employeeId AND status IN ('draft','submitted') AND deleted_at IS NULL. Returns the most recent pending timesheet (most recently updated) or null if no pending timesheets exist.

assignedTasks.description:
Open and in-progress task assignments.

Array of work items assigned to the employee that are either in open status (awaiting to be worked on) or in-progress status (currently being worked on). Limited to 5 tasks for dashboard display.

Each task includes project context for tracking scope.
assignedTasks.x-autobe-specification: Computation logic: SELECT from hrm_platform_tasks WHERE hrm_platform_employee_id = employeeId AND status IN ('open','in-progress') AND deleted_at IS NULL LIMIT 5. Joins with hrm_platform_projects for project name. Returns array of up to 5 tasks that are open or in-progress.

IPersonalDashboardView.description:
Personal dashboard view summarizing workforce metrics for the currently authenticated member within their active organization context.

Aggregated hours include today's tracked hours and this week's tracked hours, both calculated from timelog durations. The active timer field shows the currently running timer session if one exists. Recent timelog entries display the five most recent time records. The pending timesheet indicates any draft or submitted timesheet awaiting approval. Assigned tasks list open and in-progress work items.
IPersonalDashboardView.x-autobe-specification: Computed/aggregated dashboard view providing workforce metrics for the authenticated member's employee record within their active organization context. Queries multiple tables with organization scope enforcement: 1) hoursToday: SELECT SUM(duration_minutes)/60 FROM hrm_platform_timelogs WHERE hrm_platform_employee_id = employeeId AND date >= start_of_today() AND date < start_of_tomorrow() AND deleted_at IS NULL (returns 0 on NULL). 2) hoursThisWeek: SELECT SUM(duration_minutes)/60 FROM hrm_platform_timelogs WHERE hrm_platform_employee_id = employeeId AND date >= start_of_monday() AND date < start_of_next_monday() AND deleted_at IS NULL (returns 0 on NULL). 3) activeTimer: SELECT from hrm_platform_timers WHERE hrm_platform_employees_id = employeeId AND stopped_at IS NULL AND deleted_at IS NULL - joins hrm_platform_projects (project), hrm_platform_tasks (task optional), returns single timer or null. 4) recentTimelogs: SELECT TOP 5 from hrm_platform_timelogs WHERE hrm_platform_employee_id = employeeId AND deleted_at IS NULL ORDER BY created_at DESC - joins hrm_platform_projects, hrm_platform_tasks. 5) pendingTimesheet: SELECT from hrm_platform_timesheets WHERE hrm_platform_employee_id = employeeId AND status IN ('draft','submitted') AND deleted_at IS NULL - returns most recent pending timesheet or null. 6) assignedTasks: SELECT from hrm_platform_tasks WHERE hrm_platform_employee_id = employeeId AND status IN ('open','in-progress') AND deleted_at IS NULL LIMIT 5 - joins hrm_platform_projects. All queries verify hrm_platform_organization_id matches session organization.

IHrmPlatformTimer.description:
Full details of a timer tracking session for real-time work effort tracking against a project with optional task assignment.

A timer represents an active or completed work tracking clock initiated by an employee within their organization context. Timers accumulate time against the associated project and can optionally attribute time to a specific task for granular tracking. When stopped, the accumulated duration is automatically converted into a timelog entry. Discarded timers are soft-deleted without generating any timelog.

Key aspects:

- **Ownership**: Each timer is linked to the authenticated member and their active employee record within the current organization.
- **Tracking scope**: Time is always tracked against a project, and can optionally be attributed to a task within that project.
- **Lifecycle**: Active timers have null stopped_at. Stopped timers have both started_at and stopped_at populated and generate a timelog. Discarded timers have deleted_at populated and generate no timelog.
- **Billability**: The billable flag determines whether tracked hours count as billable or internal work.
IHrmPlatformTimer.x-autobe-specification:
Direct mapping from hrm_platform_timers table with BELONGS-TO relation joins.

Direct columns: id, description (nullable), billable, started_at, stopped_at (nullable), created_at, updated_at, deleted_at (nullable).

BELONGS-TO relations:
- member: hrm_platform_members_id → IHrmPlatformMember.ISummary via $ref
- employee: hrm_platform_employees_id → IHrmPlatformEmployee.ISummary via $ref
- project: hrm_platform_projects_id → IHrmPlatformProject.ISummary via $ref
- task: hrm_platform_tasks_id → IHrmPlatformTask.ISummary|null via $ref/oneOf (nullable FK)

No HAS-MANY compositions. Timer is a leaf/terminal record in the domain.

Nullable DB fields use oneOf pattern: description (String?), stopped_at (DateTime?), deleted_at (DateTime?), task (FK?).

IHrmPlatformActivityLog.x-autobe-specification: Direct mapping from hrm_platform_activity_logs table. Relations: organization via JOIN on hrm_platform_organization_id (transformed to $ref IHrmPlatformOrganization.ISummary), member via JOIN on hrm_platform_member_id (transformed to $ref IHrmPlatformMember.ISummary). HAS-MANY composition: activityLogDetails from hrm_platform_activity_log_details joined on hrm_platform_activity_log_id. FK scalars removed. entityName nullable (oneOf). CamelCase property names: action_type→actionType, entity_type→entityType, entity_id→entityId, entity_name→entityName, created_at→createdAt.

Direct mapping from `hrm_platform_project_memberships` database table.

Included columns: `id`, `capacity_role`, `created_at`.

projectId.description: The unique identifier of the project for which this budget utilization report is generated. This UUID matches the projectId used in the request path parameter, confirming which project the report applies to and enabling direct correlation with other project-specific endpoints.
projectId.x-autobe-specification: Direct mapping from hrm_platform_projects.id. Returned as a UUID-formatted string for identification and API path parameter correlation.

projectName.description: The name of the project as configured within the organization. Provides human-readable project identification in reports and dashboards, avoiding the need for additional database lookups when displaying budget utilization summaries.
projectName.x-autobe-specification: Direct mapping from hrm_platform_projects.name. Returned as a plain string for display purposes in UI components and reports.

budgetHours.description: The total configured budget hours for the project, or null if no budget has been set for this project. This value represents the planned time allocation in hours. When null, the project operates without a predefined budget constraint, and percentageConsumed will also be null regardless of actual logged hours.
budgetHours.x-autobe-specification: Direct mapping from hrm_platform_projects.budget (Float?, nullable). Returns the configured budget hours value or null if the project has no budget set. No transformation applied; value is passed through as-is.

actualHours.description: The total number of actual hours logged against this project, derived from all non-deleted timelog entries. Calculated by summing the duration_minutes from every timelog linked to this project and dividing by 60 to produce hours. Only timelogs that have not been soft-deleted (deleted_at IS NULL) are included. This value increases over time as team members log work against the project.
actualHours.x-autobe-specification: Computed aggregation from hrm_platform_timelogs via the timelogs relation on hrm_platform_projects. SUM(duration_minutes) WHERE hrm_platform_project_id = projectId AND deleted_at IS NULL, then divided by 60 to convert minutes to hours. Includes all timelogs regardless of billable status or timesheet association. Returns 0.0 if no matching non-deleted timelogs exist.

percentageConsumed.description: The percentage of the project budget that has been consumed by actual logged hours. Calculated as (actualHours / budgetHours) * 100. A value of 100 indicates the project has consumed its entire budget; values above 100 indicate a budget overrun. Returns null when the project has no configured budget or a zero budget, since division is not possible.
percentageConsumed.x-autobe-specification: Computed as (actualHours / budgetHours) * 100 when budgetHours is greater than zero. Returns null when budgetHours is null or zero. No rounding applied; returns the raw floating-point result to preserve precision for downstream calculations.

IBudgetUtilization.description:
Budget utilization report for a single project.

Returned by the GET /hrmPlatform/member/projects/{projectId}/reports/utilization endpoint. Provides a snapshot comparing the project's configured budget hours against the actual hours consumed from all timelog entries, along with a computed percentage indicating budget consumption.

This DTO serves project managers and organizational administrators monitoring resource allocation and budget compliance. If a project has no budget configured, budgetHours and percentageConsumed will be null, while actualHours will still reflect total logged time.
IBudgetUtilization.x-autobe-specification:
Aggregation DTO primarily sourced from hrm_platform_projects with timelogs aggregation via the timelogs relation.

Direct mappings:
- projectId: hrm_platform_projects.id
- projectName: hrm_platform_projects.name
- budgetHours: hrm_platform_projects.budget (Float?, nullable)

Computed aggregations:
- actualHours: SUM(hrm_platform_timelogs.duration_minutes) WHERE hrm_platform_project_id = projectId AND deleted_at IS NULL, divided by 60 to convert minutes to hours. Returns 0.0 if no matching timelogs exist.
- percentageConsumed: (actualHours / budgetHours) * 100 when budgetHours > 0. Null when budgetHours is null or zero.

Filtering: Only non-deleted timelogs included (deleted_at IS NULL). All timelogs counted regardless of billable status or timesheet association.
