Breakdown of time by billability status.

Separates client chargeable time from internal organizational work, showing total hours and the count of timelog entries for each billable category.
billable_breakdowns.x-autobe-specification: Computed from hrm_platform_timelogs. GROUP BY timelogs.billable. Aggregates SUM(timelogs.duration_minutes) / 60.0 and COUNT(*) separated by the billable (Boolean) status.

created_at.description:
Timestamp indicating when the project was initially created.

Provides an immutable audit log of the project's creation time.
created_at.x-autobe-specification: Direct mapping from hrm_platform_projects.created_at.

updated_at.description:
Timestamp indicating when the project details were last modified.

Updates automatically whenever the project's data or status changes.

IHrmPlatformProjectBudgetReport.description:
Comprehensive budget utilization report for a project. Displays the project's core attributes (id, name, color_code, status, dates) alongside calculated time tracking statistics. Aggregates all valid timelogs to compute total actual hours logged, the percentage of the planned budget consumed, structured breakdowns of time contributions by individual employees, and the separation of billable client time versus internal organizational work.

Utilization metrics are null if the project has no budget set, and actual hours default to 0 if no timelogs exist.
IHrmPlatformProjectBudgetReport.x-autobe-specification: Aggregated budget utilization report. Filters hrm_platform_projects and hrm_platform_timelogs (timelogs.hrm_platform_project_id = projectId). actual_hours = SUM(timelogs.duration_minutes) / 60.0 for timelogs.deleted_at IS NULL. utilization_percent = (actual_hours / budget) * 100.0 (or null if budget is null). employee_breakdowns = GROUP BY timelogs.hrm_platform_employee_id aggregating duration_minutes and COUNT(*). billable_breakdowns = GROUP BY timelogs.billable aggregating duration_minutes and COUNT(*) per employee. Includes direct project properties: id, name, color_code, budget, status, start_date, end_date, created_at, updated_at. Returns 404 if project not found or outside scope.

activeEmployeesCount.description:
Total number of active employees within the organization.

This metric represents the headcount of employees currently with an active status, providing an overview of the organization's current workforce size. Only employees with status 'active' are counted, excluding deactivated or terminated employees.
activeEmployeesCount.x-autobe-specification: COUNT query from hrm_platform_employees table filtered by status='active' and organization_id matching the session context. Returns an integer representing the total count of active employees.

totalHoursThisWeek.description:
Total hours logged this week across the organization.

This metric represents the sum of all time tracking entries within the current calendar week (Monday to Sunday). The value is calculated by summing duration_minutes from timelogs and dividing by 60 to convert to hours.
totalHoursThisWeek.x-autobe-specification: SUM query from hrm_platform_timelogs table filtered by date within current week (Monday to Sunday relative to current system date), organization_id matching session context via employee relationship. Sum duration_minutes and divide by 60 to get total hours as a number.

pendingTimesheetsCount.description:
Count of pending timesheets awaiting approval.

This metric represents the number of timesheets that have been submitted by employees but have not yet been approved or rejected. Provides managers with visibility into the review workload and helps track the timesheet submission lifecycle.
pendingTimesheetsCount.x-autobe-specification: COUNT query from hrm_platform_timesheets table filtered by status='submitted' where the associated employee belongs to the current organization. Returns an integer representing the count of pending timesheets.

budgetHighUtilizationProjects.description:
Projects with budget utilization over 80%.

This metric identifies projects where the actual logged hours have consumed 80% or more of the allocated budget hours. Each entry includes project details such as id, name, budget hours, actual hours, and utilization percentage. Helps managers identify projects at risk of budget overruns.
budgetHighUtilizationProjects.x-autobe-specification: Join query between hrm_platform_projects and hrm_platform_timelogs filtered by organization_id from session. Calculate actual hours as SUM(duration_minutes)/60 per project. Filter projects where (actual_hours/budget_hours) >= 0.80. Include project id, name, budget hours, actual hours, and utilization percentage. Returns an array of IHrmPlatformHighUtilizationProjectSummary.

topEmployeesByHours.description:
Top 5 employees ranked by hours worked this week.

This metric provides a performance ranking of employees based on total hours logged within the current calendar week. Includes employee details such as id, name, department, position, and total hours. Results are ordered by total hours in descending order, limited to the top 5 employees.
topEmployeesByHours.x-autobe-specification: Join query between hrm_platform_employees and hrm_platform_timelogs filtered by current week date range and organization_id from session. Group by employee and sum duration_minutes. Order by total hours descending, limited to 5 results. Include employee id, name, department, position, and total hours. Returns an array of IHrmPlatformOrganizationDashboard.ITopEmployeeByHour.

IHrmPlatformOrganizationDashboard.description:
Aggregated organizational dashboard metrics providing an at-a-glance statistical overview of the current organization context.

This dashboard consolidates key operational KPIs including workforce statistics, time tracking summaries, budget utilization alerts, and performance rankings. All metrics are strictly scoped to the organization associated with the authenticated member's active session, ensuring multi-tenancy data isolation. No parameters are required as the organization context is automatically resolved from the session.
IHrmPlatformOrganizationDashboard.x-autobe-specification:
Computed aggregation from multiple JOIN queries scoped to organization_id from active session context:

1. activeEmployeesCount: COUNT from hrm_platform_employees WHERE status='active' and organization_id matches session
2. totalHoursThisWeek: SUM(duration_minutes)/60 from hrm_platform_timelogs where date is current week (Mon-Sun) and organization_id from session via employee relationship
3. pendingTimesheetsCount: COUNT from hrm_platform_timesheets WHERE status='submitted' and employee belongs to current organization
4. budgetHighUtilizationProjects: JOIN hrm_platform_projects with hrm_platform_timelogs, calculate actual_hours=SUM(duration_minutes)/60, include projects where (actual_hours/budget_hours)>=0.80
5. topEmployeesByHours: JOIN hrm_platform_employees with hrm_platform_timelogs for current week, GROUP BY employee, ORDER BY total_hours DESC, LIMIT 5

All queries MUST enforce organization_id filtering from session for multi-tenancy isolation.

employee_id.description:
UUID identifier of the employee who performed the tracked work.

Uniquely identifies the workforce member within their organization. Used to group and aggregate all time entries belonging to this employee for the specified project.
employee_id.x-autobe-specification: Computed field from GROUP BY hrm_platform_timelogs.hrm_platform_employee_id → hrm_platform_employees.id. The employee UUID that identifies the workforce member who performed the logged work. Used as the grouping key for per-employee aggregation.

employee_name.description:
Display name of the employee shown in user interface.

Retrieved from the employee's linked member profile (hrm_platform_members.display_name). Provides human-readable identification for reporting and dashboard displays.
employee_name.x-autobe-specification: Computed field from JOIN chain: hrm_platform_timelogs → hrm_platform_employees (via hrm_platform_employee_id → hrm_platform_employee_id). Then JOIN to hrm_platform_members via hrm_platform_member_id. Result maps to hrm_platform_members.display_name. Returns the display name shown in UI for identification purposes.

total_minutes.description:
Total minutes of tracked work logged by this employee on the specified project.

Aggregated from all active (non-deleted) timelog records. Represents cumulative work duration measured in minutes, used for budget utilization calculations and work distribution analysis.
total_minutes.x-autobe-specification: Computed via SUM(hrm_platform_timelogs.duration_minutes) filtered by projectId and deleted_at IS NULL. Aggregates duration_minutes into a cumulative integer total for payroll and budget tracking.

timelog_count.description:
Number of individual timelog entries recorded by this employee for the specified project.

Counts active (non-deleted) time tracking records. Provides insight into work session frequency and logging patterns for this employee-project combination.
timelog_count.x-autobe-specification: Computed via COUNT(*) from hrm_platform_timelogs filtered by: hrm_platform_timelogs.hrm_platform_project_id = projectId AND hrm_platform_timelogs.deleted_at IS NULL AND hrm_platform_timelogs.hrm_platform_employee_id = employee_id. Counts the number of individual timelog entries for this employee on this project. Returns 0 when no timelogs exist.

IHrmPlatformProjectTimeReport.description:
Per-employee time contribution summary for a specific project, showing each employee's total logged minutes and timelog count.

Aggregates time tracking data from active (non-deleted) timelogs associated with the specified project. Joins with employee and member records to provide human-readable employee identification alongside quantitative time metrics. Results are sorted by total minutes in descending order to surface highest contributors first.
IHrmPlatformProjectTimeReport.x-autobe-specification: Per-employee time contribution aggregation from hrm_platform_timelogs JOIN hrm_platform_employees (via hrm_platform_employee_id) JOIN hrm_platform_members (via hrm_platform_member_id). GROUP BY hrm_platform_employee_id. Filters: hrm_platform_project_id = projectId AND hrm_platform_timelogs.deleted_at IS NULL. Sorted by total_minutes descending. Edge case: empty array if no timelogs exist for the project.

id.description:
UUID identifier for the task record.

Globally unique identifier generated upon task creation. Used to reference the task in API operations, task history tracking, and timelog associations.
id.x-autobe-specification: Direct mapping from hrm_platform_tasks.id. UUID primary key, auto-generated on insert.

title.description:
Core work description identifying the task.

Required text field summarizing what work needs to be done. Serves as the primary display text in task lists, project boards, and assignment notifications.
title.x-autobe-specification: Direct mapping from hrm_platform_tasks.title. String, NOT NULL.

description.description:
Extended context and acceptance criteria for the task.

Optional text providing detailed information about the task's scope, deliverables, background context, and completion criteria. Null when no extended description has been set.
description.x-autobe-specification: Direct mapping from hrm_platform_tasks.description. String, nullable. Returns null when no extended context has been provided.

status.description:
Current lifecycle position of the task.

Tracks progress through the task workflow with four allowed states: open (newly created), in-progress (actively being worked on), completed (work finished), and closed (archived). Status transitions follow a validated forward progression, and each change is recorded in the task history audit trail.
status.x-autobe-specification: Direct mapping from hrm_platform_tasks.status. String NOT NULL. Allowed values: open, in-progress, completed, closed. Default: open.

priority.description:
Urgency level indicating how quickly the task should be addressed.

Determines task ordering and sorting in project views. Allowed values are low, medium, high, and urgent. Defaults to medium at creation.
priority.x-autobe-specification: Direct mapping from hrm_platform_tasks.priority. String NOT NULL. Allowed values: low, medium, high, urgent. Default: medium.

estimatedHours.description:
Estimated work duration in hours for capacity planning.

Optional numeric value representing the expected effort required to complete the task. Used for project budget tracking, workload distribution analysis, and progress forecasting. Null when no estimate has been set.
estimatedHours.x-autobe-specification: Direct mapping from hrm_platform_tasks.estimated_hours. Float (DoublePrecision), nullable. Mapped to camelCase property name. Returns null when no estimate has been provided.

dueAt.description:
Deadline date and time when the task should be completed.

Optional timestamp indicating when the work item is due. Used for deadline tracking, overdue task identification, and timeline visualization in project calendars. Null when no specific deadline has been assigned.
dueAt.x-autobe-specification: Direct mapping from hrm_platform_tasks.due_at. DateTime (Timestamptz), nullable. Mapped to camelCase property name. Returns null when no deadline has been set.

createdAt.description:
Timestamp when the task was first created.

Immutable server-generated timestamp recorded in ISO 8601 format. Used for chronological sorting, audit trail purposes, and determining task age.
createdAt.x-autobe-specification: Direct mapping from hrm_platform_tasks.created_at. DateTime NOT NULL, auto-generated on insert. Mapped to camelCase property name.

updatedAt.description:
Timestamp of the most recent modification to the task.

Mutable server-generated timestamp updated whenever any task attribute changes, including status transitions, title edits, priority adjustments, or assignment changes.
updatedAt.x-autobe-specification: Direct mapping from hrm_platform_tasks.updated_at. DateTime NOT NULL, auto-updated on any row modification. Mapped to camelCase property name.

deletedAt.description:
Soft-delete timestamp indicating task deactivation.

Nullable field that is null for active tasks. When a task is soft-deleted, this field is set to the current timestamp. Soft-deleted tasks are excluded from active listings and reports but retain their full record for audit trail preservation.
deletedAt.x-autobe-specification: Direct mapping from hrm_platform_tasks.deleted_at. DateTime nullable. Mapped to camelCase property name. Null for active tasks; populated with timestamp when soft-deleted.

project.description:
The project that owns and scopes this task.

Tasks are always associated with exactly one parent project, which provides organizational context and data isolation. The project summary includes name, color code, status, budget, and timeline information.
project.x-autobe-specification: BELONGS-TO relation transformed from hrm_platform_project_id FK. JOIN hrm_platform_projects on id. Returns IHrmPlatformProject.ISummary. NOT NULL — tasks always belong to exactly one project.

assignedEmployee.description:
The employee responsible for completing this task.

Optional reference to the project employee assigned to execute the work item. Assigned employees must be active project members. When null, the task is unassigned and available for work. Provides employee summary including member profile, role, department, and employment details.
assignedEmployee.x-autobe-specification: BELONGS-TO relation transformed from hrm_platform_employee_id FK. JOIN hrm_platform_employees on id. Returns IHrmPlatformEmployee.ISummary. Nullable — null when task is unassigned (hrm_platform_employee_id IS NULL).

parentTask.description:
Parent task reference for subtask nesting hierarchy.

Optional self-referential link enabling one-level subtask nesting. When present, this task is a subtask of the referenced parent task, which must belong to the same project. The parent task cannot itself have a parent (enforcing single-level nesting only). When null, this is a top-level task.
parentTask.x-autobe-specification: BELONGS-TO self-referential relation transformed from parent_id FK. JOIN hrm_platform_tasks on id recursively. Returns IHrmPlatformTask.ISummary. Nullable — null when task is not a subtask (parent_id IS NULL). One-level nesting enforced: parent tasks cannot have their own parent.

IHrmPlatformTask.description:
Full task entity representing a discrete work item within a project.

Tasks progress through a lifecycle of statuses: open, in-progress, completed, or closed. Each task has a priority level (low, medium, high, urgent), optional estimated hours for capacity planning, and an optional due date. Tasks can be assigned to a project employee and support one-level subtask nesting for hierarchical work decomposition.

The owning project is always included as a summary reference. Timestamps track creation and modification. Soft-deleted tasks retain their record with the deletedAt field populated for audit trail preservation.
IHrmPlatformTask.x-autobe-specification:
Direct mapping from hrm_platform_tasks table with FK-to-$ref transformation for all belongs-to relations.

Direct columns mapped to DTO properties:
- id → id (UUID PK)
- title → title (String NOT NULL)
- description → description (String nullable)
- status → status (String NOT NULL: open, in-progress, completed, closed)
- priority → priority (String NOT NULL: low, medium, high, urgent)
- estimated_hours → estimatedHours (Float nullable, mapped via camelCase)
- due_at → dueAt (DateTime nullable, mapped via camelCase)
- created_at → createdAt (DateTime NOT NULL, mapped via camelCase)
- updated_at → updatedAt (DateTime NOT NULL, mapped via camelCase)
- deleted_at → deletedAt (DateTime nullable, mapped via camelCase)

BELONGS-TO relations transformed from FK scalars to $ref objects:
- project: REQUIRED $ref to IHrmPlatformProject.ISummary via hrm_platform_project_id (JOIN hrm_platform_projects on id)
- assignedEmployee: OPTIONAL $ref to IHrmPlatformEmployee.ISummary via hrm_platform_employee_id (JOIN hrm_platform_employees on id, null if unassigned)
- parentTask: OPTIONAL $ref to IHrmPlatformTask.ISummary via parent_id (self-referential JOIN hrm_platform_tasks on id, null if not a subtask)

Excluded relations (HAS-MANY):
- subtasks — recursive composition, accessed via separate API
- timelogs — aggregation relation for time tracking, accessed via dedicated timelog endpoints
- hrmPlatformTimers — aggregation relation for active tracking sessions, accessed via dedicated timer endpoints
- histories — aggregation relation for task status change audit trail, accessed via dedicated task history endpoints

All column-to-DTO property mappings follow camelCase convention. FK columns are excluded as they are exposed through their corresponding relation objects.

employee.description:
The workforce member who recorded work time against this project.

Identifies the individual contributor associated with the aggregated hours and timelog count for the project.
employee.x-autobe-specification: Computed relation from hrm_platform_timelogs. The aggregation groups by the hrm_platform_employee_id column. Resolves to IHrmPlatformEmployee.ISummary by joining hrm_platform_employees.id with hrm_platform_employee_id.

hours.description:
Total hours logged by the employee against the project.

Calculated by summing all non-deleted timelog durations (stored in minutes) and dividing by 60 to convert minutes to hours. This aggregate metric represents the total actual work effort recorded by this specific employee for the project.
hours.x-autobe-specification: Computed aggregation from hrm_platform_timelogs. hours = SUM(timelogs.duration_minutes) / 60.0 for all non-deleted timelogs where hrm_platform_project_id matches the target project and timelogs.hrm_platform_employee_id matches the employee and timelogs.deleted_at IS NULL. Returns a float (number) representing total hours.

timelog_count.description:
The number of individual timelog entries created by this employee for the project.

Represents the count of discrete time tracking sessions (excluding soft-deleted records). This metric helps distinguish between one continuous work session and multiple shorter tracking events by the same employee against the same project.
timelog_count.x-autobe-specification: Computed aggregation from hrm_platform_timelogs. timelog_count = COUNT(*) where hrm_platform_project_id matches the target project, hrm_platform_employee_id matches the employee, and deleted_at IS NULL. Returns an integer with minimum 0.

IHrmPlatformProjectBudgetReport.IEmploye.description:
Per-employee time contribution record showing an individual workforce member's total hours logged against a project and the count of discrete timelog entries they created.

Used primarily in project budget utilization and time tracking reports. It groups all recorded work effort for a single project, segmenting the data by the employee who performed the work. The `employee` field identifies the contributor, `hours` provides the aggregated duration, and `timelog_count` indicates how many separate time-sessions were logged.

This breakdown supports analytical views for managers to see how project budgets are distributed across individual team members.
IHrmPlatformProjectBudgetReport.IEmploye.x-autobe-specification: Computed aggregation from hrm_platform_timelogs grouped by hrm_platform_employee_id. hours = SUM(duration_minutes) / 60.0 for non-deleted timelogs matching the target project. timelog_count = COUNT(*) of timelogs per employee. employee references IHrmPlatformEmployee.ISummary via join to hrm_platform_employees. Filter: timelogs.deleted_at IS NULL and hrm_platform_project_id matches target project.

id.description: Unique identifier for the activity log detail record.
id.x-autobe-specification: Direct mapping from hrm_platform_activity_log_details.id. UUID primary key auto-generated by the database.

key.description:
Attribute name identifying the type of metadata stored in this detail record.

Examples include 'oldStatus' and 'newStatus' for task status changes, 'rejectionReason' for rejected timesheets, 'oldRoleId' and 'newRoleId' for role reassignments.
key.x-autobe-specification: Direct mapping from hrm_platform_activity_log_details.key. Attribute name identifying the metadata type. Unique within the parent activity log alongside hrm_platform_activity_log_id.

value.description:
String-encoded value of the metadata attribute.

All detail values are stored as strings to maintain uniformity across different action types. Values may represent status labels, reason texts, identifiers, or other action-specific data for audit purposes.
value.x-autobe-specification: Direct mapping from hrm_platform_activity_log_details.value. String-encoded metadata value stored uniformly across action types.

created_at.description: Timestamp when this detail entry was created by the system. Provides temporal context for when the metadata was attached to the log.
created_at.x-autobe-specification: Direct mapping from hrm_platform_activity_log_details.created_at. ISO 8601 timestamp set automatically when the detail entry is created alongside its parent activity log.

updated_at.description:
Timestamp when this detail entry was last modified.

Updated whenever the detail value is amended. Activity logs are generally immutable but allow detail corrections for audit accuracy during the initial recording window.
updated_at.x-autobe-specification: Direct mapping from hrm_platform_activity_log_details.updated_at. ISO 8601 timestamp updated whenever the detail value is amended.

IHrmPlatformActivityLogDetail.description:
Key-value detail record providing audit context for a specific governance action.

Activity log details decompose polymorphic action metadata into atomic, structured key-value pairs to maintain strict 1NF compliance. Each detail captures exactly one attribute relevant to the logged event, such as status transitions (oldStatus, newStatus), rejection reasons (rejectionReason), or role reassignment history (oldRoleId, newRoleId).

Detail records are always accessed as part of their parent activity log entry and serve as the immutable audit trail metadata.
IHrmPlatformActivityLogDetail.x-autobe-specification: Direct mappings from hrm_platform_activity_log_details. All columns (id, key, value, created_at, updated_at) are mapped directly. Excluded: hrm_platform_activity_log_id (parent foreign key not exposed in DTO as detail records are always accessed through their parent activity log via HAS-MANY composition), activityLog (reverse belongs-to relation excluded as this DTO serves as a composed element within activity log responses).

id.description:
The unique identifier of the project.

Used to reference the project in subsequent API calls for retrieving full details, managing members, or viewing tasks and timelogs associated with the project.
id.x-autobe-specification: Derived from hrm_platform_projects.id (UUID primary key). This aggregation joins hrm_platform_projects.id to uniquely identify the project and enable navigation to full details.

name.description:
The name of the project.

Identifies the project in the budget alert list and helps managers quickly recognize which projects are at risk of exceeding their allocated time budgets.
name.x-autobe-specification: Derived from hrm_platform_projects.name. Required non-nullable field that identifies the project in list displays and reports.

budgetHours.description:
The planned budget hours for the project.

Represents the total estimated hours for project work. Only projects with a defined non-null budget appear in this high-utilization list, as they are the only ones that can be measured against actual time consumption.
budgetHours.x-autobe-specification: Derived from hrm_platform_projects.budget (Float/DoublePrecision). Only projects with non-null budget values are included in high-utilization reports. The non-null DTO constraint is enforced by query filter excluding null budget projects.

actualHours.description:
The total actual hours logged against the project by all employees.

Computed by summing the duration_minutes of all non-deleted timelogs for this project and converting to hours. This value is compared against budgetHours to determine utilization percentage.
actualHours.x-autobe-specification: Computed aggregation from hrm_platform_timelogs: SUM(duration_minutes) / 60, grouped by project_id. Only non-soft-deleted timelogs (deleted_at IS NULL) are included in the summation. Results in total hours (not minutes) for display consistency with budgetHours.

utilizationPercentage.description:
The percentage of budget hours consumed by actual logged time.

Calculated as (actualHours / budgetHours) multiplied by 100. Only projects at or above 80 percent budget utilization appear in this list, acting as a critical indicator for project managers to track potentially at-risk projects.
utilizationPercentage.x-autobe-specification: Computed value: (actualHours / budgetHours) * 100. Only projects where utilizationPercentage >= 80.0 are included in this DTO's result set. The minimum: 80 JSON Schema constraint documents this filtering threshold.

IHrmPlatformHighUtilizationProjectSummar.description:
Summary of a project with budget utilization at or above 80%, showing budget hours, actual hours logged, and utilization percentage.

This type appears in the organization dashboard's budget alert list, helping managers identify projects at risk of exceeding their allocated time budgets. Each entry includes the project identifier, planned budget hours, actual hours consumed from employee timelogs, and the computed utilization percentage.

Used exclusively in response DTOs — never appears in request bodies or query parameters.
IHrmPlatformHighUtilizationProjectSummar.x-autobe-specification:
Computed aggregation from JOIN hrm_platform_projects with hrm_platform_timelogs scoped to organization_id from active session context:
    - id: hrm_platform_projects.id (UUID primary key)
    - name: hrm_platform_projects.name (project identification)
    - budgetHours: hrm_platform_projects.budget (Float/DoublePrecision). Only non-null budgets qualify for filtering.
    - actualHours: SUM(duration_minutes) / 60 from hrm_platform_timelogs GROUP BY project_id, excluding soft-deleted timelogs (deleted_at IS NULL).
    - utilizationPercentage: (actualHours / budgetHours) * 100, computed only when >= 80.0.
    
    Multi-tenancy: All queries MUST be filtered by organization_id matching the authenticated member's active session context.

billable.description:
Determines if this breakdown represents billable or non-billable time.

Returns true for client chargeable hours and false for internal organizational work. Aggregates all time entries for the project that match this exact billability classification.
billable.x-autobe-specification: Derived from hrm_platform_timelogs.billable grouping logic. The Boolean value being grouped to separate client chargeable work (true) from internal organizational work (false).

total_hours.description:
Total hours logged in this billability category.

Represents the aggregated duration of time entries that fall into either the billable or non-billable category. Computed by summing raw duration minutes and dividing by 60.0, rounded to represent decimal hours for financial reporting.
total_hours.x-autobe-specification: Computed aggregation. Calculates SUM(hrm_platform_timelogs.duration_minutes) / 60.0 for timelogs matching the grouped billable flag and the referencing project where deleted_at IS NULL. If no timelogs exist for this billable category, total_hours will be 0.

timelog_count.description:
The number of individual timelog entries within this billability category.

Counts the exact number of time tracking records classified as either billable or non-billable, filtered by the project scope and excluding soft-deleted entries.
timelog_count.x-autobe-specification: Computed aggregation. Calculates COUNT(*) of hrm_platform_timelogs matching the grouped billable flag and the referencing project where deleted_at IS NULL. If no timelogs exist for this billable category, timelog_count will be 0.

IHrmPlatformProjectBudgetReport.IBillabl.description:
Billable time breakdown showing total hours and timelog count.

Separates project time into client chargeable (billable=true) versus internal organizational (billable=false) work. Each breakdown object represents one billability classification with the aggregated total hours logged and the number of individual time entries that fall into that category. Returns exactly two objects per budget report: one for billable hours and one for non-billable hours.
IHrmPlatformProjectBudgetReport.IBillabl.x-autobe-specification: Computed aggregation type based on hrm_platform_timelogs. Groups time entries by billability flag. Calculates billable (the grouped Boolean value), total_hours (SUM(duration_minutes) / 60.0), and timelog_count (COUNT(*)) for timelogs belonging to the referenced project where deleted_at IS NULL. Returns exactly two breakdown objects per budget report: one with billable=true and one with billable=false. If no timelogs exist for a billable category, both total_hours and timelog_count will be 0.

position.description:
Optional job title or position name.

Human-readable position title assigned to the employee within the organization. Provides role context alongside department information. Null if no position title has been specified for this employee.
position.x-autobe-specification: Direct mapping from hrm_platform_employees.position column. Nullable string field storing the optional job title or position name for the employee within the organization.

department.description:
Optional department affiliation for organizational context.

References the department within which the employee is grouped. Provides department name and hierarchical parent information for organizational structure display. Null when the employee reports directly to the organization without a specific department assignment.
department.x-autobe-specification: Join from employees.hrm_platform_department_id to hrm_platform_departments.id via the department relation. Returns IHrmPlatformDepartment.ISummary with id, name, parentDepartment, and timestamps. Nullable when employee has no department assignment.

member.description:
Linked member profile for display name and contact information.

References the global user account associated with this employee. Provides the display name shown in the dashboard ranking, along with email, avatar, and phone number. Member profiles are shared across all organizational contexts.
member.x-autobe-specification: Join from employees.hrm_platform_member_id to hrm_platform_members.id via the member relation. Returns IHrmPlatformMember.ISummary containing display_name, email, avatar_image, and phone_number for identification and display purposes.

totalHours.description:
Total hours logged during the current calendar week.

Aggregated sum of all timelog durations for this employee within the current week (Monday through Sunday). Duration values are summed in minutes and converted to hours (divided by 60). Only active, non-deleted timelogs are counted. Primary ranking metric for the top employees visualization on the organization dashboard.
totalHours.x-autobe-specification: Computed aggregation field. Calculated as SUM(timelogs.duration_minutes) / 60.0 for all non-deleted timelogs belonging to this employee within the current calendar week (Monday through Sunday) and matching the organization_id from the authenticated session context. Only timelogs with deleted_at IS NULL are included. Result is a floating-point number representing total hours worked.

id.description:
Unique identifier for the employee.

Universally unique identifier (UUID) that represents the employee record within the organization. Serves as the grouping key for aggregating timelog hours and uniquely identifies each ranked employee in the dashboard.
id.x-autobe-specification: Direct mapping from hrm_platform_employees.id. UUID primary key identifying the employee record used in the hours aggregation grouping.

IHrmPlatformOrganizationDashboard.ITopEm.description:
Top employee ranking entry showing hours worked during the current calendar week.

Each entry represents an employee ranked by total hours logged, combining employee identity (UUID), linked member profile for display name, optional department affiliation, optional position title, and the computed total hours worked. This data powers the organization dashboard's top 5 employee ranking visualization.

Used by managers to recognize high contributors and monitor workload distribution across the team.
IHrmPlatformOrganizationDashboard.ITopEm.x-autobe-specification:
Join aggregation from hrm_platform_employees with hrm_platform_timelogs, filtered by current calendar week date range and organization_id from authenticated session context. Results grouped by employee and ordered by computed total hours descending, limited to top 5.

Data source mapping:
- id from employees.id
- member from employees.hrm_platform_member_id joined to hrm_platform_members via $ref to IHrmPlatformMember.ISummary
- department from employees.hrm_platform_department_id joined to hrm_platform_departments via $ref to IHrmPlatformDepartment.ISummary (nullable - employees may lack department assignment)
- position from employees.position column (nullable)
- totalHours computed as SUM(timelogs.duration_minutes) / 60.0

Only active employees (status = 'active') with non-deleted timelogs are included.
